defects.observed: s has fields feasTol (1e-3) and other (5)
defects.expected: OUTPUTS: 'paramStructureOut, with fields removed corresponding to paramNames'

notes: Minimal reproduction (MATLAB, after initCobraToolbox; restore with CobraSolverState.restore(s0)): s0 = CobraSolverState.get(); changeCobraSolverParams('LP', 'feasTol', 1e-9); getCobraSolverParams('LP', 'feasTol') % -> 1e-06, expected 1e-09; getCobraSolverParams('LP', 'feasTol', 'default') % -> 1e-09, expected 1e-06; [a, s] = getCobraSolverParams('LP', 'feasTol', struct()) % -> 1e-09 (the struct path honours the globals as documented); CobraSolverState.restore(s0). The two wrong-result defects are mirror images: the 2-argument call behaves as 'default' should and vice versa. The ledger lists ~70 callers (incl. optimizeCbModel, fluxVariability, parseSolverParameters -> every solveCobra*), so this quarantine blocks a large part of the campaign; the struct path used by parseSolverParameters is not affected. Lead/second reader should confirm before blocking callers. Other observations (not defects): 1-argument call errors with MATLAB:minrhs (paramNames is a required input); unknown problemType prints 'Unrecognized solver type' and returns no outputs.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: two-input calls skip globals, line 66; default sets overRideDefaults=1, line 61); maintainer 2026-11-15: two-input form is a defect

defects.title: The printed path is cut at a folder name with a % sign
defects.trigger: a folder named '100%done' on environment.path; restoreEnvironment(environment, true, 1)
defects.observed: 'Path set to:' followed by '<tempdir>/100' and nothing more (environment.path is used as the sprintf format; %d without data stops the output); the path itself is restored correctly
defects.expected: every folder of the path, one per line

notes: The environment is built by hand from the current globals (getGlobalValue) and path, so every restore returns to the initial state; the test's own globals are removed. The printLevel 1 section prints every global and the full MATLAB path (~1800 lines) once: unavoidable to reach line 67 (a short path makes MATLAB report 'The path may be bad'). On Windows the ':' split of line 67 would also break drive letters (not observable here).

defects.title: convertToDNF of an AndNode without children stops with an error
defects.observed: 'Index exceeds array bounds.' in AndNode.nextcombination line 189
defects.expected: a DNF node (empty nodes are not defined by the class)

notes: exempt: 131 dead code (convertToDNF of every Node subclass returns an AndNode or OrNode, never a LiteralNode). Coverage tool lists each line twice for classdef files (lines=216, missed [131, 131]). Runtime edges not in the static graph: AndNode/OrNode call methods of their children (LiteralNode.contains/evaluate/toString/convertToDNF/getLiterals, Node.copy/addChild/getLiterals), so the real cycle is {AndNode, OrNode, LiteralNode, Node}; LiteralNode and Node are still PENDING and these tests also rely on them (hand-built trees, getLiterals, isDNF, hasNestedChildren). Empty nodes (no children) are not supported (limitation recorded); they arise from deleteLiteral, so the lead may want to reconsider the severity. convertToCNF goes through OrNode.convertToCNF -> combineChildren, which has a recorded wrong-result defect (identical generated clauses, testCombineChildren.m); inputs here avoid it.
